title: lastrea illicita
intro: Lastrea illicita, commonly known as the Illicit Fern, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, thereby providing potential health benefits in managing cardiovascular and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea illicita include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various conditions such as arthritis and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of Lastrea illicita include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antiproliferative activities.
